title: Isolate runner host env vars from test child processes
goal: Under KainBain task 0f0213b7-25f6-4930-8470-a73dc0611529 the only full-CI signal on record failed in Harness Self-Tests (tests/install-runner-wrapper.test.mjs, 3 tests: see docs/tasks/0f0213b7-25f6-4930-8470-a73dc0611529/automated-test-2-failure-20261114-201542.md) solely because the CI host exports KAINBAIN_RUNNER_INSTALL_ROOT and spawned test children inherited it, so assertions about install paths observed the host layout instead of the fake test HOME. It was patched test-only (childEnv strip) as an out-of-scope drive-by. Make the structural fix: centralize env sanitization for spawned test children (strip or allowlist runner host vars such as KAINBAIN_RUNNER_INSTALL_ROOT in the shared test helper and/or the runner wrapper itself) and audit sibling tests for host-env dependence, so CI hosts with different environments cannot flip results. Acceptance: Harness Self-Tests pass both with and without the host variable set.
